tfimpact: 1 change destroys data, 1 change interrupts service, 1 routine
Plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 2 to destroy (1 replacement, 1 forgotten, 2 unchanged). Terraform/OpenTofu 1.15.5 · 6 resources.

CRITICAL (1)
  * aws_sqs_queue.work["orders"] is renamed to aws_sqs_queue.work["order_events"] without a moved block, so it will be destroyed and recreated [PLAN-RENAME-001]
    aws_sqs_queue.work["orders"] will be destroyed because its for_each key changed, and aws_sqs_queue.work["order_events"] will be created with the same name ("fixture-lifecycle-orders"). Terraform does not know they are the same object. The SQS queue would be destroyed with it, losing every message still in the queue.
    -> Add a moved block (from = aws_sqs_queue.work["orders"], to = aws_sqs_queue.work["order_events"]) so Terraform changes the address in state instead. Applying as planned also tries to create a resource with the same name, which fails for globally named resources.

MEDIUM (1)
  * aws_iam_role.deploy will be destroyed and recreated [PLAN-REPLACE-001]
    The IAM role is replaced because name ("fixture-lifecycle-deploy-v1" → "fixture-lifecycle-deploy-v2") cannot be changed in place. The new object is created before the old one is destroyed (create_before_destroy).
    -> Check that the identifiers other systems hold for this resource (ARN, ID, DNS name, IP) are not referenced outside Terraform, or plan a cutover.

ROUTINE (1)
  * aws_cloudwatch_log_group.legacy: removed from state but not destroyed
